title: Pair adjacent circuits
statement: Given a Boolean $b$ and a list of Boolean tree circuits, form a new list by replacing each consecutive pair of circuits with a single node whose gate is AND if $b$ is true and OR if $b$ is false, and whose two children are that pair. Repeat this operation on the remaining list; an empty list stays empty, and an unpaired final circuit is carried over unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a list of Boolean tree circuits on $n$ variables
